text: Now, let us imagine you survive this surreal ordeal through the sheer benevolence of science-fiction logic.
You endure the ten longest, most terrifying seconds of your life, shivering in the silent, pitch-black void.
Finally, the brass mechanism reaches the tenth second.
The golden crown clicks back into place.
Time violently snaps back into reality.
What happens the instant time restarts?

All the air molecules you displaced while struggling suddenly rush inward at supersonic velocity to fill the vacuum you left behind, creating a concussive shockwave that detonates like a bomb right against your ears.
The millions of frozen photons that piled up against your retinas strike your eyes in an explosive, blinding burst of pure white illumination.
The roar of car engines, the blast of sirens, and the bustling shouts of pedestrians crash back into your auditory senses with overwhelming force.
You collapse onto your knees on the concrete sidewalk, your chest desperately drinking in the warm, turbulent, moving air.
You clutch that golden pocket watch with trembling, sweaty fingers, and a profound realization washes over your mind.
Time is not a prison or an inconvenience to be escaped.
Time is the sacred, dynamic rhythm that makes heat, light, sound, breath, and conscious thought possible.
Without time, the cosmos is nothing more than a dead, frozen monument.
You slowly slip the watch back into your pocket, turn around, and walk forward into the warm, moving current of everyday life.
